id: \rY: My name is Y. I've spent many long hours flying in the sky, training to become a Sky Trainer.
en: \rY: My name is Y. I've spent many long hours flying in the sky, training to become a Sky Trainer.
it: \rY: Mi chiamo Y. Ho passato lunghissime ore a volare in cielo, allenandomi per diventare un'Aviallenatrice.

id: \rBecause of that I've been given the title Flyer.
en: \rBecause of that I've been given the title Flyer.
it: \rPer questo mi è stato dato il titolo di Aviatrice.

id: \rY: You've got a lot of skill. I look forward to the next battle.
en: \rY: You've got a lot of skill. I look forward to the next battle.
it: \rY: Hai un gran talento. Non vedo l'ora di lottare di nuovo.
